content:
maya: Heads-up for tonight's change window. Freeze starts in 30m. Short checklist: pin in place, canary plan, monitoring owners, rollback route. Reply with :thumbsup: when youre good.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed. Pins applied: service=api-llm version=v3.5.0. Canary group: cg-21 (10% traffic). Artifact SHA: a1b2c3f. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/cg-21/1725004321
trey: I'll own metrics for first 20m. Dashboards linked: https://dashboards.redwood/example/canary/21. Watching p95/p99, 5xx, and token-cost per request.
eng-lead: PM signed off earlier. No hotfixes during freeze unless severity=sev1 + director OK. Keep any change requests brief.
sre-oncall: Ops thresholds to watch: 5xx >= 0.4% sustained 2m -> alert; p95 > 1000ms sustained 3m -> page. Also watch backend error ramp (delta > +0.25%). Pager goes to #sre-oncall then eng-lead.
product: Quick Q: any expected feature flags to flip? Im going to hold marketing comms until 100% stable.
maya: No new flags. Were enabling the quant-opt path behind the pin; expect short warmup. Will limit embeddings to 25 RPS for first 5m to avoid cache churn.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: 10% now. Health checks: pass. No 5xx in first 60s. Next evaluation at +5m.
trey: If we see KV cache miss storm, plan is: 1) throttle embeddings, 2) bump replicas, 3) rollback if sustained errors. Rollback command saved below.
trey: ```
# rollback to stable pinned version
redwood deploy rollback --service api-llm --to-version v3.4.9 --reason "canary: error/latency breach"
```
sre-oncall: I've pushed a temporary autoscaler policy (policy id: pol-404) to prevent cold starts. Also added a short-term circuit to limit concurrency to avoid OOMs.
maya: Final readout before freeze: - pin ok (deploy-bot) - monitoring owners trey/sre-oncall - rollback cmd ready (trey) - release notes link posted below
maya: Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/v3.5.0 - note: improved kv caching, kernel update, potential initial latency spike.
product: Copy. We'll wait for the 10m green signal before announcing.
deploy-bot: Canary health OK at +2m. No alerts triggered. Holding for the 5m evaluation. Automated heartbeat every 90s.
eng-lead: Keep this thread for launch comms. If rollback happens, announce here and in #incident. Short updates only.
maya: :thumbsup: proceeding to freeze in 30m. If anyone needs an exemption, ping eng-lead + director in #urgent.
trey: I'll post any metric flickers here. Silence = healthy progression.
sre-oncall: Standing by.
